evidence: Source reads and edits only; no builds, tests, syntax checks, project/game execution, game launch, attachment or process inspection

reference.base: Fabric CosmeticsLayer.draw and drawLimbs pass the supplied light to CuboidModel; drawMesh passes it to MeshDraw
reference.glow: Cuboid glow uses fullBright; shared MeshDraw selects FULL_BRIGHT for glow and sheen

port.input: WorldFrame.Player.packedLight and AvatarRenderer.Avatar.packedLight: nullable Java packed block/sky light for the same actor/frame
port.roles: Skin pieces, bent emote limbs, base cuboids/meshes, Java cape boxes and both Java/native-pose wing boxes receive the explicit light argument
port.preview: Missing input retains the existing software full-bright fallback; it does not establish scene provenance
port.staging: NativeAvatarGeometry snapshots the scene source per batch; changing actors clears it, changing light during a partial quad rejects the transaction, and known lit vertices must match their batch's source value
port.wire: ARCGEO01 batch flag 4 conveys sceneLightKnown without altering the byte layout; old readers reject the new flag
port.consumer: Native material preparation rejects nonempty lit batches lacking scene provenance before GPU commands; emissive glow does not need packed scene light
port.replay: Body samples v4 record optional packed light with the actor pose; playback uses that archived value and never borrows the viewer's live light. Exact endpoints preserve the observation; interior values survive only when both known endpoints agree. See replay-packed-scene-light-source.json.
